scope: Source binding and constructive protocol repair only; no new full loop

physical_definitions.S: sigma/H, dimensionless STF directional Hubble-slope shear
assumptions: full-sphere target projection or explicit processed estimator response

magnitude_quadrupole.consequence: Shat=-Qhat/kappa requires nonlinear quadrupole remainder, data, finite-z, selection and calibration errors; Q_mu is not S

octupole.domain: Angular local-logarithm truncation; excludes finite distance and selection

finite_redshift.magnitude_order: generically O(z) after dividing by leading z and taking log
finite_redshift.explicit: d_L=d_L1[1+z a1(n)+O(z^2)] => f_mu(z)=-kappa ln(1+q)+kappa z a1(n)+O(z^2)
finite_redshift.when_magnitude_O_z2: Only after modeling/subtracting linear-z correction or a specified cancellation
finite_redshift.optional_bound: If relative distance error<=alpha zmax<1, Bz<=sqrt(35/2)|kappa| alpha zmax/(1-alpha zmax) for ideal fullsphere octupole
finite_redshift.Bsel: Must bound actual selection/estimator operator on a registered signal/nuisance class

premises: input bounds on one joint event or deterministic feasible set
uncertain_shear.epsilon_requirement: Must hold over joint admissible region; Dmax+||Shat||_op+eS<1 is sufficient

optional_kappa_uncertainty.meaning: Separate multiplicative magnitude calibration; kappa itself is exact

inverse.near_zero_S: Use response-set test; absolute inverse gain diverges

joint_test.key: The vector and perpendicular inequalities share the same seven-component error budget; passing each is only necessary
joint_test.counterexample: Orthogonal components0.8B each pass split unit thresholds but joint=sqrt(1.28)B>B
joint_test.optimization: Finite convex trust-region in3D; impose Dmax and positivity in physical feasible set
joint_test.correlations: Prefer original joint error body/law and shared nuisances; inflated B is a conservative outer envelope

interpretation.compatible: Joint response image intersects observed joint region under stated error model
interpretation.discrepancy: Can reject the specified response/error model
interpretation.cause_attribution: Requires different registered finite-z, selection, observer/source and coupling responses; compatibility does not establish a unique cause
interpretation.depth: Retain shared calibration and cross-window covariance/joint error set; common d,S only if same-event model warrants
